title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: A stellar 1973 performance highlighted by a legendary Dark Star, captured on an audience tape of fair fidelity.
ai_review.review: The show is celebrated for its soaring Dark Star (over 30 minutes), tight set flow and upbeat “TLEO” moments, with many fans rating the music itself as near‑perfect. The audience recording is uneven – clear enough to hear each instrument but marred by occasional hiss, pitch quirks and occasional crowd noise – leaving the technical quality at a fair level.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers award high marks for the musical performance (especially Dark Star) while consistently noting recording flaws; weighting show quality higher yields a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to follow the jams, but suffers from hiss, occasional pitch issues and uneven volume; some listeners call it 'weak' while others praise its clarity compared to other audience tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, exploratory jams (notably Dark Star) are balanced by concise, upbeat numbers; the pacing keeps the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his expansive improvisation on Dark Star, delivering space‑y, arpeggiated passages that drive the jam.
